description: This file defines the structure and types for TLV (Type-Length-Value) classes related to Wi-Fi Map Channel Scan Results, including class definitions, enums, and comments explaining the usage.

classes.name: tlvProfile2ChannelScanResult
classes.description: Class representing the channel scan result profile with fields like type, length, radio UID, operating class, channel, scan success status, and scan result details.

classes.name: cRadioScanResult
classes.description: Class capturing individual radio scan data such as timestamp, utilization, noise, neighbors list, scan duration, and scan type.

classes.name: cNeighbors
classes.description: Class representing neighboring BSS entries, including BSSID, SSID, signal strength, bandwidth, and optional load info.
